name: @ocs/encoding
//: Encodings: hex, Base32, Base58, Base64, CBOR. The first four come from @scure/base, which is already audited and already in the tree; CBOR is @ocs/algos, because no library met this app's constraints. Every tool is bidirectional -- `direction` is an option rather than two tools, since Base64 and un-Base64 are one thing with an arrow on it. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand half.
